Euphorica

A downloadable game

Buy Now$5.00 USD or more

Euphorica is a sandbox game focused on realistic Euphoria-style ragdoll physics. You can mess around with characters, test different interactions, and create chaotic or funny moments using dynamic physics. It also supports mods, so players can add their own content and expand the game however they want.
